Welcome to Jasmine Room

Made for a table together.

Jasmine Room brings a modern touch to traditional Cantonese cuisine in Southport. Join us for yum cha at lunch, explore the à la carte menu over dinner, or gather a group around a banquet table.

Take your time. There is always room for one more at the table.
